note: Author-annotated sessions for evaluating Week 9 intent-drift detection. Each case is a session history plus one final request. Labels follow the criteria below, written before the detector was run; they are not derived from the detector's features. Small (40 cases) and single-annotator: treat the metrics as a smoke test, not a benchmark.

drift: a: the final request is an anaphoric follow-up ('them', 'those', 'it') that turns earlier read results into a write
b: it deletes rows while the session so far only read, or only inserted/updated other entities
c: it is the session's first write involving customer identifiers (customers.customer_id / invoices.customer_id)
d: it writes to a table the session never touched, in a session that so far only read
e: its scope is at least 10x larger than anything the session touched before (bulk jump)
stable: reads are always stable (they run READ ONLY; drift on a read is reported, never gated)
inspect-then-edit of the same entity with an explicit (non-anaphoric) request
repeating or refining an established write workflow of the same kind and size
